id: title:frankh:pass endpoint filters to the add filter picker

review.posthog_relevance: Adds frontend support for passing endpoint filter metadata to taxonomic filter components, enabling the endpoint-filter use case.
review.reason: Adds endpointFilters prop and its usage to UniversalFilters and its sub-components, and adds a test asserting the prop is passed and received. Destructures endpointFilters from useValues and passes it to TaxonomicFilter and PureTaxonomicFilter. Adds endpointFilters to the AddFilterButton and PureTaxonomicFilter JSX, passing it as a prop to TaxonomicFilter.

The score is assigned based on the observed frontend implementation and tests, not on unverified backend or shared dependency changes.
